description.fallback: The captives wait for Ōga to announce the next experiment. A few complain of thirst, Fugō trying in vain to exchange his luxury watch for another captive's water. The Kusa-nin agrees with Boruto that they need to cooperate to survive.

intro.fallback: The captives wait for Ōga to announce the next experiment.
A few complain of thirst, Fugō trying in vain to exchange his luxury watch for another captive's water.
The Kusa-nin agrees with Boruto that they need to cooperate to survive.

outro.fallback: An older captive sneezes, blowing out his candle, and dies. Ōga explains the candle flame is their life, showing them lanterns to carry them.
He adds how passing the candles from person to person works, the person not holding a candle dying if one goes out on someone else's hand.
